H: A correction restricted to the row space of the class-centered linear head preserves ideal teacher class probabilities with at most nine dimensions in this ten-class model, but may not preserve the learned/compiled pipeline or hidden NMSE.
Calibration-only task-margin and residual-energy screens computed before candidate fitting can predict an adequate dimension; their failures and over-selection must be reported, not hidden.
Changing only QR basis construction order may alter downstream classification even when downstream fitting data order and random streams are held fixed.

T.teacher_and_data: Exact C68E repaired Residual-MLP; C72E nested384 calibration; C73E train/validation split and Gaussian sigma .36; held-out test never evaluated.
T.qr: Original canonical_nested_qr of calibration residual.T, float32; reverse and permutation act ONLY on the basis construction input. All fits retain identical original data order.
T.residual_svd: Uncentered calibration residual float64 SVD; first right singular vectors, cast float32 for fitting; no validation use.
T.centered_head_svd: Subtract class mean from each column of teacher.head.weight in float64; first right singular vectors ordered by singular value, cast float32 for fitting. Require numerical rank9 at relative threshold1e-10 for this fixed architecture. This is head-sensitivity ordering, NOT residual-energy or Fisher optimization.
T.mapping: Same 4096-parameter hierarchy/final TinyRes, 600 updates, batch128, same seed offsets+715000/+716000/+717000 as C73E; no final teacher blending.
T.prefit_prediction: For each basis family, choose smallest tested dimension meeting each screen, otherwise fallback64. Energy screen: calibration residual remaining squared energy fraction<=0.05. Margin screen: fraction of calibration examples failing strict 2*max_absolute_centered_logit_error < teacher_top1_minus_top2_margin is<=0.01. Screen thresholds are engineering hypotheses, not universal constants. Record chosen dimensions and all screen values before any candidate fits; validation labels/activations not used for basis or selection.
T.oracle_diagnostic: For head9 calculate ideal correction in float64 and assert centered logit relative Frobenius error<=1e-10 on calibration and validation. Oracle uses actual teacher residual and is NOT a deployable prediction. Separate its validation task behavior from H and final S.
T.preflight: Synthetic projector/centered-logit preservation and three-state gate tests. Bridge71300 P64 and D64 state hashes, metrics, data hashes must match C73E N384 on the same pinned CPU environment before fresh outcomes.
T.environment: Python3.11, torch2.13.0 CPU, numpy2.4.6, scikit-learn1.9.0, torch_threads1; capture actual CPU/build. Local other-version results must not be pooled.
T.bootstrap: 100000 paired model-seed percentile95, common index matrix, seed751384202

D.gate_states: Lower95>margin PASS; upper95<margin FAIL; otherwise UNCERTAIN. For maximum NMSE ratio: upper95<1.25 PASS; lower95>1.25 FAIL; otherwise UNCERTAIN.
D.reference_prerequisites: Robust teacher shifted-minus-clean accuracy lower95>-20pp; P64 final-minus-teacher and D64-minus-teacher lower95>-5pp. If prerequisites fail, report geometry only and select no dimension.
D.candidate_gates: Final candidate-minus-P64 accuracy lower95>-2pp AND candidate/P64 hidden NMSE geometric ratio upper95<1.25. Also report task-only gate distinctly; do not discard NMSE after observing results.
D.primary_mechanism_comparison: centered_head_svd9 versus P64: task NI and dual utility/NMSE results separately; ideal preservation versus learned mapping distinction is mandatory.
D.order_effects: Report fixed reverse-minus-identity and permutation-minus-identity paired accuracy contrasts at each dimension. Exploratory comparisons are not multiplicity-corrected confirmatory findings.
D.predictor_evaluation: For every seed/family/screen report selected dimension, whether its FINAL empirical seed utility delta>=-2pp and NMSE ratio<=1.25, and dimension regret against smallest tested successful dimension. Aggregate success intervals over model seeds, not over dependent cells. These are diagnostic empirical outcomes, not per-seed CI-based proofs.
D.followup_selection: Only after a valid P64/D64 reference, advance a mechanism/candidate to a separately named fresh followup. No universal minimum, architecture comparison or public-main promotion.

C: Exact ideal head-observable preservation can coexist with poor fitted/compiled performance.
Residual energy and classification-margin screens may fail because mapping approximation/generalization, not projection error, dominates.
Order changes may strongly change residual capture but weakly change final accuracy.
Reference validity may again be uncertain; failed NI does not prove inferiority.
U: Fixed digits split and calibration subsets; seed intervals do not quantify new-dataset uncertainty.
Head-observable projection uses the complete retained classifier head and is an output-specific statement, not universal hidden-state reconstruction.
Class-centered-head rank bound is standard linear algebra, not a claim of a novel theorem.
No speed/memory/energy claim; no Residual-CNN or SmallViT transfer.
Calibration reuse is384 examples with76800 draws per fit; no inference-time teacher calls are permitted in compiled model evaluation.
All outcomes exploratory; no positive claim from synthetic tests or ideal oracle alone.
